item.title: Italian ministry funds Talon-X hypersonic interceptor study with MBDA
item.description: The Talon-X work focuses on propulsion for hypersonic flight above Mach 5.
item.content:encoded:
Home | News

The Talon-X work focuses on propulsion for hypersonic flight above Mach 5.

MBDA said test results will feed a Italian decision expected in July 2027.

The study, reference HYP-695, runs for 29 months.
